size_rationale: Medium because the cause sits one step away from the symptom, in the custom password validator shared by register, reset-password and the users routes; it only shows on reset-password because the model validator rescues the other routes.
prompt: POST /v1/auth/reset-password with a letters-only new password such as 'password' returns 401 'Password reset failed' instead of a 400 validation error. Register still rejects the same password with 400.

root_cause.detail: The shared Joi password validator uses && instead of ||, so it only rejects passwords with neither letters nor digits. Register and the users routes are rescued by the Mongoose model validator (400), but reset-password's catch-all turns the failed save into 401.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/reset-password > should return 400 if password is missing or invalid
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 400 if password is missing or invalid'
